dedup_audit: M47_bounded_actual_20261121/audit_registration.py writes DEDUPLICATION_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json and performs zero native evaluations

call_path.environment: M47_PRIVATE_EXEC_ROOT must be the extracted executor-only tree outside the git checkout. The driver and the audits resolve witnesses, M20 preflight plans, and K1 execution rows only through private_root.py.
call_path.launcher_reads: FRESH_JOB_REGISTRATION.json jobs, which are the canonical fresh jobs after fingerprint dedup
call_path.worker_does: check_core against EXPERIMENT_CORE_FREEZE.json, load the staged nominal, assert H against the private M20 preflight S plan and alg._nominal_reference_H, read the recorded witness through TestWorld, then run_episode

roles.S: Staged nominal S, recovery policy S
roles.R: Same staged nominal S, recovery policy X. No second nominal search.
roles.X: Staged nominal X, recovery policy X

controls.M44_CURRENT: M44 fresh nominal plans executed by this frozen M47 recovery core. M44 and M46 nominal plans and H are the same; this comparison does not replay an old M44 or M46 process.
controls.K1: Historical executions/own/dev rows are a reference for flags and H after a fresh execution exists. They are not fresh jobs and are not members of FRESH_JOB_REGISTRATION jobs.

budgets.rescue: one extension of the init budget by main_eval when init finds nothing
